_comment: A station's line, played once a game before the premium notice, the first time that station pays the captain the new-market premium: a sale, at a real margin, of a legal good bought at another station (polish design 5.4). Loot, a mission's cargo and goods bought at that station open nothing. One per market system but the Fulcrum, whose premium notice plays alone; Heron's Mark has no market. The Godot port reads this file (bug bash BB-27); Python does not. Working text for the writing session.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Purchasing associate, Central Exchange
first_sale_lines.text: New supplier. Every field of the form before your next load. Field five asks your reason for entering this market. Leave it blank. Everyone does.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Cooperative buyer
first_sale_lines.text: We pay over the Guild's transport rate. You're not the Guild. Unload at the grain shed.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Intake counter
first_sale_lines.text: Guild desk and Union desk both want to be the one paying you. You're paid. They can settle the rest.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Shift foreman
first_sale_lines.text: First names on this deck. Bay two. Second shift breaks it down by morning.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Procurement officer
first_sale_lines.text: Office of Procurement, Materials Division. Delivery accepted. Compensation commensurate with first-supplier terms has been transferred.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Stallholder
first_sale_lines.text: Leave it by the stall. Your name? Tell me after. You eat first.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Wrecker
first_sale_lines.text: Worth half what you think. Set it down by the breaking yard. The gate pays you over anyway.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Buyer, Grand Bazaar
first_sale_lines.text: First lot from you, so I pay over list. Next time, bring me where it came from. The story sells it here.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Quartermaster
first_sale_lines.text: Leave it by the lift. You're the supplier now. The last one transferred out.

first_sale_lines.speaker: Buyer
first_sale_lines.text: No names. Payment comes off the open board, over list.
